name: Netherlands

flag.description: Three equal horizontal stripes of red, white and blue.
flag.symbolism: It derives from the orange-white-blue 'Prince's Flag' of William of Orange; the orange was gradually replaced by red in the 17th century.

hook: The Dutch flag is red-white-blue with a dark navy bottom; Luxembourg's bottom is light sky-blue, and Paraguay adds a crest in the middle.
trivia: On King's Day and royal occasions the flag is flown with an orange pennant above it, honouring the House of Orange.
About a quarter of the Netherlands lies below sea level.
